entities.summary: Anthony Michael Sherman is an American former professional football player who was a fullback in the National Football League (NFL), primarily with the Kansas City Chiefs. He played college football for the UConn Huskies and was selected by the Arizona Cardinals in the fifth round of the 2011 NFL draft. His nickname is "Sausage".
